ammonia.reason: 21-30 day age with low deamination by Lactococcus starter gives minimal NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and no surface smear limits p-cresol, indole and skatole.

bitter.reason: Washed-curd removes lactose and bitter hydrophobic peptides; short rennet proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone blue ketones.

browning.reason: Residual lactose plus whey protein and lysine gives moderate Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus citrate fermentation to diacetyl/acetoin retained in high-fat washed curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Short age and low lipase activity gives very low butanoic/hexanoic free fatty acids.

creaminess.reason: 45-52% moisture, ~32% fat and young intact fat globules give smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Cohesive washed rennet gel at pH 5.0-5.4 deforms rather than fractures.

firmness.reason: Semi-soft 41-45% moisture and 1-month proteolysis gives sliceable soft body.

floral_honey.reason: Minimal phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol in young curd.

fruity.reason: Very low esterase activity in 30 days limits ethyl butanoate/hexanoate formation.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat lacks high 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goat acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Trace Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine gives hint of nuttiness.

melt.reason: pH ~5.2 calcium-paracasein network with high moisture/fat flows readily on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No Geotrichum/mold surface so almost no 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one.

oil_off.reason: High 29-33% fat with young emulsion releases moderate free oil when melted.

smoky.reason: Not smoked with no wood pyrolysis guaiacol/syringol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Curd washing removes lactose/whey so Lactococcus makes only mild lactic/acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Not pasta-filata; melted paracasein flows rather than forming aligned strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Mild pasteurization and no high cook limits H2S/methional/dimethyl sulfide.

sweet.reason: Low salt, low acid, residual lactose and diacetyl perceived as milky-sweet.

umami.reason: Short 3-4 week proteolysis yields low free glutamate and savory peptides.
